title: Source-level DWG AcDs/ACIS route capabilities and consumer qualification
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source implementation archaeology and plan update

localScope.head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
localScope.worktreeState: Broadly modified and uncommitted before this pass; preserve unrelated work and do not stage or commit.

sources.observation: Current source includes read_2007_section_acds and acds_private, so LibreDWG has a real AcDs parsing route. The explicit incomplete-datastore/brute-force SAB text in NEWS is in the historical 0.11 entry, not the latest 0.14.1 release entry. Issue #1411's public reproducer sends ezdxf DXF through LibreDWG dxf2dwg and then dwg2dxf; its intermediate DWG lacks the section, so it does not exercise the read path. Its separate confidential AutoCAD R2018 input is unavailable for independent reproduction.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source and project-authored issue report; no peer build, binary, or input was executed.
sources.planDisposition: Classify as partial parser with current reliability not established by the historical NEWS text. Prove the AcDs section exists before any reader comparison; otherwise mark NOT_EXERCISED.

sources.observation: Release v3.6.51 includes #1139's DXF/DWG ACIS-payload read route and #1154's full Prototype_1b parsing. On 2026-10-21 #1174 remains open; dependent writer PR #1240 remains open and names #1174 as a dependency.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Released implementation candidate and mutable PR status; no exact package/runtime or independent geometry result was executed here.
sources.planDisposition: Use a pinned released version as an optional structural comparator. Keep reader and unmerged writer evidence separate.

sources.observation: The README/changelog advertises DWG/DXF and ACIS SAT/SAB/B-rep functionality. Visible R2018 AcDs tests use both a fabricated minimal SAB for attachment/mispairing checks and a cube generated by the project's planar-body builder, then use its own DWG writer and reader. These tests target structural and same-codec consistency. The README points to third-party code-provenance notices, but those notices and decoder provenance were not audited. The project belongs to the broader ACadRust/OpenCADStudio ecosystem, so a separate repo is not automatically an independent evidence lineage.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project claims and source-visible self-tests; no peer code, binary, external-producer artifact, or native CAD application was run.
sources.planDisposition: Candidate/not admitted at PAR-144. Audit source provenance and exact release before any comparison; do not count same-codec roundtrips or synthetic SAB as independent semantics.

sources.project: ezdxf ACIS tools and drawing addon
sources.observation: ezdxf explicitly has no ACIS kernel and does not target arbitrary ACIS structures, but documents creating and extracting simple known flat-polyhedron SAT/SAB bodies. Its drawing addon does not render ACIS and projects 3D entities to the XY plane.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project capability documentation; no local generation or downstream import was run.
sources.planDisposition: Use only as a bounded scratch polyhedron/carrier control and raw SAT/SAB inspection aid, not an arbitrary-solid semantic oracle or renderer.

sources.project: FreeCAD DXF and DWG import documentation
sources.observation: The documentation says embedded binary ACIS/SAT solids are not readable by the built-in or legacy DXF importer, and DWG import uses an external converter followed by the DXF importer; converter selection can vary.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Current consumer documentation; no FreeCAD build or platform execution was performed.
sources.planDisposition: Retain native FreeCAD platform qualification for its documented entity subset and converter route, but classify stock FreeCAD as UNSUPPORTED_BY_CONSUMER for embedded ACIS semantics.

existingOwners: PAR-144 optional peer and compatibility checkpoint

implementationReadiness.defaultAction: Continue dependency-ready local implementation; optional peer and consumer checks remain at the existing composed checkpoint.
sequence: Keep fast local tests first and self-unblock after each completed slice.
Before a peer read check, verify the exact input contains AcDsPrototype_1b and record section, schema/index, payload, and owner/key join separately.
Use released ACadSharp v3.6.51 as an optional structural reader candidate; keep open #1174/#1240 branch evidence separate.
Audit ACadRust provenance before treating it as an independent comparator; same-codec and fabricated-SAB tests are structural controls only.
Use ezdxf only for its documented simple polyhedral ACIS profile and raw carrier inspection.
Use FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification only for its documented importer subset and converter route; do not count it as an embedded-ACIS semantic consumer.
Do not download or commit external fixtures or add peer dependencies for this research update.

limitations: This was source, release-note, test-source, issue, and consumer-documentation review only; no peer executable, package, drawing, native app, or local test ran.
GitHub source, release, and PR state is mutable; pin exact refs before a future optional run.
ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte-layout questions.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
